list.name: site
list.label: Sucursal
list.query: SELECT store_name AS __text, store_id AS __value FROM sites WHERE status = 'operational' ORDER BY store_name

panels.title: Comparativa vs promedio del grupo
panels.description: Variación de cada KPI de esta sucursal respecto al promedio del grupo (sucursales operativas) en el período. Verde = mejor que el promedio, rojo = peor. Devoluciones invertido (menos es mejor). Valor y promedio en el tooltip.

targets.rawSql: WITH per AS (SELECT c.store_id, SUM(p.sales)::float/NULLIF(SUM(c.ins),0) AS conv, SUM(p.items_sale)::float/NULLIF(SUM(p.sales),0) AS upt, (COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_sale),0)-COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_return),0))/100.0/NULLIF(SUM(p.sales),0) AS ticket, (COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_sale),0)-COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_minor_return),0))/100.0/NULLIF(MAX(s.sales_area_m2),0) AS spm, SUM(p.items_return)::float/NULLIF(SUM(p.items_sale),0) AS devol FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON c.store_id=p.store_id AND c.bucket_day=p.bucket_day WHERE s.status='operational' AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY c.store_id), me AS (SELECT * FROM per WHERE store_id='$site'), a AS (SELECT AVG(conv) conv, AVG(upt) upt, AVG(ticket) ticket, AVG(spm) spm, AVG(devol) devol FROM per) SELECT 'Tasa de conversión' AS "Indicador", (me.conv-a.conv)/NULLIF(a.conv,0) AS "Δ% vs promedio", round((me.conv*100)::numeric,1)||'%' AS "Valor", round((a.conv*100)::numeric,1)||'%' AS "Promedio", 1 ord FROM me,a UNION ALL SELECT 'Unidades por ticket', (me.upt-a.upt)/NULLIF(a.upt,0), round(me.upt::numeric,2)::text, round(a.upt::numeric,2)::text, 2 FROM me,a UNION ALL SELECT 'Ticket promedio', (me.ticket-a.ticket)/NULLIF(a.ticket,0), '$'||round(me.ticket)::bigint::text, '$'||round(a.ticket)::bigint::text, 3 FROM me,a UNION ALL SELECT 'Facturación/m²', (me.spm-a.spm)/NULLIF(a.spm,0), '$'||round(me.spm)::bigint::text, '$'||round(a.spm)::bigint::text, 4 FROM me,a UNION ALL SELECT 'Tasa de devolución', (a.devol-COALESCE(me.devol,0))/NULLIF(a.devol,0), round((COALESCE(me.devol,0)*100)::numeric,1)||'%', round((a.devol*100)::numeric,1)||'%', 5 FROM me,a ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Pico de ocupación por día y hora
panels.description: Pico típico de ocupación (promedio del máximo de personas dentro del local en cada hora) de esta sucursal, por día de la semana y hora. Sirve para dimensionar la dotación: cuánta gente suele haber en el momento más cargado de cada franja.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT extract(isodow FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS dow, extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS hr, max_occupancy AS occ FROM occupancy_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) SELECT CASE dow WHEN 1 THEN 'Lun' WHEN 2 THEN 'Mar' WHEN 3 THEN 'Mié' WHEN 4 THEN 'Jue' WHEN 5 THEN 'Vie' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sáb' WHEN 7 THEN 'Dom' END AS "Día", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=10),0),0) AS "10:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=11),0),0) AS "11:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=12),0),0) AS "12:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=13),0),0) AS "13:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=14),0),0) AS "14:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=15),0),0) AS "15:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=16),0),0) AS "16:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=17),0),0) AS "17:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=18),0),0) AS "18:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=19),0),0) AS "19:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=20),0),0) AS "20:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=21),0),0) AS "21:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(occ) FILTER (WHERE hr=22),0),0) AS "22:00" FROM d GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow

panels.title: Perfil de afluencia — días de semana
panels.description: Visitantes promedio por hora del día (00-23), lunes a viernes del rango seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (SELECT extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int hr, ins FROM counting_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND extract(isodow FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') <= 5), b AS (SELECT min(hr) lo, max(hr) hi FROM h WHERE ins > 0) SELECT g AS "Hora", COALESCE(round(AVG(h.ins), 0), 0) AS "Visitantes" FROM b CROSS JOIN generate_series(b.lo, b.hi) g LEFT JOIN h ON h.hr = g GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

panels.title: Perfil de afluencia — fin de semana
panels.description: Visitantes promedio por hora del día (00-23), sábados y domingos del rango seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: WITH h AS (SELECT extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int hr, ins FROM counting_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND extract(isodow FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= 6), b AS (SELECT min(hr) lo, max(hr) hi FROM h WHERE ins > 0) SELECT g AS "Hora", COALESCE(round(AVG(h.ins), 0), 0) AS "Visitantes" FROM b CROSS JOIN generate_series(b.lo, b.hi) g LEFT JOIN h ON h.hr = g GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

panels.title: Visitantes
panels.description: Personas que entraron a esta sucursal en el período seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_day = min(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz WHEN bucket_day = max(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz ELSE (bucket_day::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' END AS time, SUM(ins) AS "Visitantes" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tasa de conversión
panels.description: Promedio ponderado de compradores / visitantes de esta sucursal. Requiere que la sucursal envíe transacciones POS.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_day = min(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz WHEN bucket_day = max(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz ELSE (bucket_day::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' END AS time, SUM(sales)::float / NULLIF(SUM(visits), 0) AS "Conversión" FROM conversion_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Facturación
panels.description: Ventas menos devoluciones de esta sucursal en el período. En pesos argentinos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_day = min(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz WHEN bucket_day = max(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz ELSE (bucket_day::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' END AS time, SUM(amount_minor_sale - amount_minor_return) / 100.0 AS "Facturación" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ticket promedio
panels.description: Facturación neta dividida por la cantidad de compradores de esta sucursal (excluye devoluciones del denominador).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_day = min(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz WHEN bucket_day = max(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz ELSE (bucket_day::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' END AS time, (SUM(amount_minor_sale) - SUM(amount_minor_return))::float / NULLIF(SUM(sales), 0) / 100.0 AS "Ticket promedio" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Unidades por ticket
panels.description: Unidades vendidas ÷ compradores (UPT) de esta sucursal: cuántas prendas se lleva en promedio cada comprador.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN bucket_day = min(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz WHEN bucket_day = max(bucket_day) OVER () THEN $__timeTo()::timestamptz ELSE (bucket_day::timestamp + INTERVAL '12 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires' END AS time, SUM(items_sale)::float/NULLIF(SUM(sales),0) AS "UPT" FROM pos_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Hora más ocupada
panels.description: La hora del día con mayor ocupación promedio (personas dentro del local) de esta sucursal. Útil para planificar staff.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lpad(hora::text,2,'0')||':00' AS "Hora" FROM (SELECT extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int hora, AVG(avg_occupancy) occ FROM occupancy_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id = '$site' AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY hora ORDER BY occ DESC LIMIT 1) t

panels.title: Embudo de conversión
panels.description: Embudo: tráfico externo → cercano → visitantes → compradores, cada etapa como % del tope (tráfico externo = 100%). Pasá el mouse para ver la cantidad absoluta de cada etapa.

targets.rawSql: WITH t AS (SELECT SUM(w.passersby) ext, SUM(w.shoppers) cer, SUM(c.ins) vis, SUM(p.sales) comp FROM counting_by_bucket_day c FULL OUTER JOIN wifi_ble_by_bucket_day w ON c.store_id=w.store_id AND c.bucket_day=w.bucket_day FULL OUTER JOIN pos_by_bucket_day p ON COALESCE(c.store_id,w.store_id)=p.store_id AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day,w.bucket_day)=p.bucket_day WHERE COALESCE(c.store_id,w.store_id,p.store_id) = '$site' AND COALESCE(c.bucket_day,w.bucket_day,p.bucket_day) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date) SELECT 'Tráfico externo' AS "Etapa", ext::float/NULLIF(ext,0) AS "% del tope", to_char(ext,'FM999,999,999') AS "Cantidad", 1 ord FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 'Tráfico cercano', cer::float/NULLIF(ext,0), to_char(cer,'FM999,999,999'), 2 FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 'Visitantes', vis::float/NULLIF(ext,0), to_char(vis,'FM999,999,999'), 3 FROM t UNION ALL SELECT 'Compradores', comp::float/NULLIF(ext,0), to_char(comp,'FM999,999,999'), 4 FROM t ORDER BY ord
